plugins.name: context-cache
plugins.description: A panel above the prompt: context usage, session / weekly / Fable limits, and prompt-cache temperature, with Clear, Compact and Warm (keeps the cache from going cold while you are away), the price of each message and of what Clear or Compact saved, auto-warm above a context size, a one-line mode, and alerts when the cache has 5 minutes left or a limit reaches 90%.
